title: Header shows logo, all 7 nav links in order and search icon
test_data: Expected nav order: Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote, Get a Sample
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Look at the header at the top of the page
Read the nav labels left to right
expected_result: Header shows the Skyline logo, the links Products, Portfolio, Resources, About, Contact, Get a Quote, Get a Sample in this order, and a search icon. No label is missing, truncated or wrapped onto a second line.

title: Nav link hrefs point to the correct pages
test_data: Products=/products/; Portfolio=/projects/; Resources=/resources/; About=/about/; Contact=/contact/; Get a Quote=/quote-request/; Get a Sample=/sample-request/
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Read the href attribute of each of the 7 header nav links
expected_result: Each href resolves to the path listed in Test Data (same dev host). Note: the label is "Portfolio" while the URL is /projects/.

title: Logo links to the home page
steps: Open /about/ on the dev environment and wait for the page to finish loading (about 3 seconds, so hero animation completes)
Click the Skyline logo in the header
expected_result: Browser navigates to the home page (/) on the dev host; the home page renders without an error.

title: Search icon opens the search UI
